user_query: I'm a researcher studying the correlation between global recession and anime viewership. Fetch the latest articles from 7 different publications about worldwide recession news and provide me with the article titles, URLs, and sources. Additionally, fetch the most up-to-date anime news list and provide me with the article titles, summaries, categories, topics, publication dates, thumbnails, URLs, IDs, and API URLs.
